task.title: Build independent persistent owners for Persona Capital Runtime and Deployment writes

owned_layer: Persistent Persona registry owner store and HTTP API
Authenticated Persona mutation identity and lifecycle-owner policy enforcement
Canonical CapitalPool patch operation in services/capital/pg_store.py
Fresh-instance readback proof for Persona, CapitalPool, DeploymentPlan, and RuntimeBinding
not_changing: Every main.py entrypoint, including services/capital/main.py and services/control-plane/bff/main.py
live broker or live capital authority

persistence.persona: AtomicJsonRecordStore or PostgresJsonOwnerStore selected by PERSONA_STORE_BACKEND; reads always hit the selected owner store
persistence.capital: Existing JSON/Postgres Capital owner stores extended with the canonical pool patch operation
persistence.deployment: Existing file-backed DeploymentPlan owner reused without a shadow implementation
persistence.runtime: Existing file-backed RuntimeManager owner reused without a shadow implementation

persona_mutation_authority.authentication_default: strict bearer verification; missing or unverifiable credentials fail closed
persona_mutation_authority.actor_binding: request actor_id must equal the authenticated actor
persona_mutation_authority.create_owner: persona.admin; newly created personas must start in draft
persona_mutation_authority.lifecycle_owners: draft -> research_only belongs to persona.admin; Governance Plane roles own promotion, freeze, revalidation, and retirement transitions
persona_mutation_authority.decision_execution: non-owner execution requires a server-provided GovernanceDecisionVerifier bound to decision id, persona id, source state, and target state

acceptance.evidence: Persona writes use a service-owned durable record store; Capital writes remain inside services/capital; existing Deployment and Runtime owners are exercised directly.
AST acceptance scans the four owner modules and found no read_store import.

Four task tests create a fresh Persona owner/app, Capital owner store, DeploymentPlanStore, and RuntimeManagerService after each write and verify persisted identity/readback; the AST test enforces the read_store import boundary.

acceptance.criterion: Persona lifecycle authority is fail closed
acceptance.evidence: HTTP negative tests reject unauthenticated callers, untrusted roles, spoofed actor_id, caller-invented decision ids, direct live_owner creation, Persona Plane promotion beyond research_only, and generic PATCH lifecycle bypass without changing persisted state. Positive tests cover exact Persona/Governance role ownership and exact server-side Governance decision verification.
git diff --name-only origin/dev...HEAD -- ':(glob)**/main.py' returned no paths; services/control-plane/bff/read_store.py is also unchanged.
No services/source_ingestion path changed; the Persona owner only persists required_data_sources declarations and starts no poller or scheduler.

commands.conclusion: No main.py, BFF read_store.py, or Source Ingestion changes

deployment.reason: This task establishes owner code and integration contracts; the downstream command-port/deployment task performs compose wiring and hosted acceptance.
